page.overview:
Who is Mantis Devil?

The |Kamakiri no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of mantises.

The Mantis Devil has only been partially seen thus far, possessing massive, sickle-like limbs with dark-green coloration which unearth from any surface they're summoned under.

The Mantis Devil's personality is currently unknown.

Two Public Safety Devil Hunters, under the control of Makima, summoned a sickle of the Mantis Devil from ground to stop Power and Denji escaping by clapping their hands. It slashed open Power's left side, however it was not enough to stop her.
